metadata.title: GitHub Profile Builder
metadata.description: Organize and improve how your GitHub profile looks, with drafts, README templates and a preview before you apply anything.

layout.footer: Independent project, not affiliated with GitHub.

drafts.title: Drafts
drafts.empty: You have no drafts yet. Create the first one from your current profile.
drafts.confirmDelete: Delete the draft “{title}”? This cannot be undone.

errors.limitReached: You reached the limit of {max} drafts. Delete one to create another.
errors.github: We could not read your GitHub profile. Please try again.
errors.database: We could not reach the database. Please try again.

new.title: New draft
new.description: The draft starts with your current GitHub profile data. Editing the draft changes nothing on GitHub.
new.titleHint: Optional. If left blank, today's date is used.
new.readmeNote: README: if your profile README was published by this app, the draft starts with the same settings. A README written another way is not imported; the draft starts from the default template and only replaces the current one if you apply it.

drafts.selected: {count, plural, =0 {None selected} one {# selected} other {# selected}}
drafts.confirmBulkDelete: {count, plural, one {Delete # draft?} other {Delete # drafts?}} This cannot be undone.

apply.title: Review and apply to GitHub
apply.intro: Check what will change on your profile. Nothing is sent to GitHub until you confirm.
apply.saveFirst: Save the draft before reviewing and applying.
apply.noChanges: Nothing to change: it already matches GitHub.
apply.emailRemovalNote: If GitHub does not accept removing the public email through the API, do it in Settings → Public profile.

readme.create-repo: The public {login}/{login} repository does not exist and will be created to show the README on your profile.
readme.create-file: The {login}/{login} repository has no README yet; it will be created.
readme.update: The current README of {login}/{login} will be replaced. GitHub keeps the commit history, so the previous version can be recovered.
readme.blocked: Your repositories could not be read right now and this README lists projects. To avoid publishing without them, the README cannot be applied. Reload the page to try again.

apply.limits: These cannot be changed through the API and will not be applied: avatar and pinned repositories.
apply.nothingToApply: There is nothing to apply: your GitHub already matches this draft.

results.title: Result

reasons.expired: Your GitHub session expired or was revoked. Sign in again and retry.
reasons.rateLimited: GitHub is temporarily limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and retry.
reasons.permission: GitHub denied permission for this change.
reasons.validation: GitHub rejected the data that was sent.
reasons.privateRepoExists: A private {login}/{login} repository already exists. The README only shows on your profile if that repository is public: make it public in its GitHub settings and retry.
reasons.github: Could not reach GitHub. Please retry.
reasons.conflict: Your GitHub profile changed since the review. Reload the page to review again.
reasons.unknown: GitHub did not answer in time: the change may or may not have been made. Reload the page to check the current state.
reasons.notAttempted: Not attempted because the previous step failed.

results.allApplied: Done: the selected changes were applied to GitHub.
results.someFailed: Some changes were not applied. The draft is still saved and you can retry.
results.unconfirmedHelp: GitHub accepted the request, but the change does not show on your profile. Check on GitHub; you may need to do it manually in Settings → Public profile.

errors.stale: Your GitHub profile or this draft changed since the review was opened. Nothing was applied. Reload the page to review again.
errors.nothingSelected: Select at least one part to apply.
errors.github: We could not read your GitHub profile right now. Nothing was applied. Please retry.
errors.database: We could not read the draft. Nothing was applied. Please retry.
errors.readmeBlocked: The README was not applied because your repositories could not be read. Nothing was applied. Reload the page and retry.
errors.loginChanged: Your GitHub username changed since you signed in. Sign out and in again before applying.

apply.confirmCreateRepo: Note: a public {login}/{login} repository will be created on your account.

readmePreview.title: README preview
readmePreview.note: Rendered by GitHub itself from the Markdown that will be published. Nothing is sent to your profile here.
readmePreview.copyFailed: Could not copy. Select the text and copy it manually.
readmePreview.empty: No section has content yet. Turn sections on and fill in the texts in the README tab.
readmePreview.missingProjects: {count, plural, one {This project was not found among your public repositories and will be left out of the README:} other {These projects were not found among your public repositories and will be left out of the README:}} {names}

errors.github: We could not render the visual preview right now. The Markdown view shows the exact content.
errors.rateLimited: GitHub is temporarily limiting requests. The visual preview returns in a few minutes; the Markdown view stays up to date.
errors.tooLarge: The README is too large for the visual preview.
errors.expired: Your GitHub session expired or was revoked. Save the draft and sign in again to see the visual preview.

readmeEditor.intro: The README shows at the top of your profile and comes from the {login}/{login} repository.

classic.name: Classic
classic.description: Technology icons and projects as a list.

minimal.name: Minimal
minimal.description: Text only: technologies as “Java · C# · Python”, no images.

compact.name: Compact
compact.description: Smaller icons and projects in a table.

language.hint: Language of the template's fixed texts, such as section titles.

sections.hint: Turn each section on or off and use the arrows to change the order. The greeting always stays at the top. Switching templates does not change the order.

hints.greeting: If blank, the template uses a default greeting with your name.
hints.contact: Uses the links set in the Profile tab: website, public email, X and social accounts.
hints.intro: Up to {max} characters. Markdown is allowed: lists, links, **bold**. Use the title to show “About me” above the text.

projects.hint: Choose up to {max} of your public repositories.
projects.empty: You have no public repositories yet.
projects.unavailable: We could not load your repositories right now. Reload the page to try again.

headings.title: Title (optional)
headings.hint: Recommended: “{fallback}”. Clear the text to show no title.

list.name: List
list.description: One contact per line, with the full address.

inline.name: Inline links
inline.description: Website • X • LinkedIn, on a single line.

contactStyle.attribution: Network icons: Simple Icons (CC0) and Devicon (MIT). Website, email and other links: Material Design Icons (Apache 2.0).

custom.hint: Create up to {max} sections of your own, like “Learning”, “Skills” or “Certifications”, with text and/or technologies. {count} of {max} created.
custom.added: Custom section added at the end of the list.
custom.title: Title (optional)
custom.titleHint: Leave it empty to show the section without a title.
custom.textHint: Markdown is allowed, as in “About me”.
custom.groupByCategory: Group by category (Languages, Frameworks...). Unchecked, everything goes in a single list.

hints.title: Only for you to identify the draft. It is not sent to GitHub.
hints.email: GitHub only accepts one of your account's verified emails as the public email.
hints.social: Up to {max} links, with the full URL (https://…).
hints.hireable: Tells GitHub you are open to job offers. Recruiting tools can read it; it is not shown prominently on your profile.

draftEditor.emailsUnavailable: We could not load your verified emails right now. Reload the page to try again.
draftEditor.confirmDiscard: You have unsaved changes. Leave and discard them?

preview.title: Profile preview
preview.note: A visual approximation of your GitHub profile sidebar. Avatar and pinned repositories are not changed here.

draftEditor.limitsNote: Avatar and pinned repositories cannot be changed through the GitHub API. Change them directly on GitHub.
draftEditor.saved: Draft saved. Nothing was changed on GitHub.

errors.invalidUrl: Use full URLs starting with http:// or https://.
errors.invalidUsername: Use up to 15 letters, numbers or _.
errors.invalidEmail: Choose one of your verified GitHub emails.
errors.failed: We could not save. Your changes are still in the form; please try again.
errors.notFound: This draft was deleted and can no longer be saved.

profile.title: Your current GitHub profile
profile.description: Data read from GitHub just now. Nothing here changes without your confirmation.

readme.title: Profile README
readme.no-public-repo: No public {login}/{login} repository found. That repository shows the README on your profile, and GitHub only displays it when the repository is public.
readme.no-readme: The {login}/{login} repository exists but has no README yet.
readme.ready: Your profile README is published at {login}/{login}.

profile.repositories: {count, plural, =0 {No public repositories} one {# public repository} other {# public repositories}}

pinned.title: Pinned repositories
pinned.note: The GitHub API cannot change pinned repositories. To change them, use “Customize your pins” on your GitHub profile.

errors.rateLimited: GitHub is temporarily limiting requests. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.generic: We could not load your GitHub data right now.

errors.session_expired: Your GitHub session expired or was revoked. Please sign in again.
errors.access_denied: You cancelled the authorization on GitHub. Try again whenever you like.
errors.invalid_state: The sign-in expired or could not be verified. Please sign in again.
errors.oauth_failed: We could not complete the sign-in with GitHub. Please try again.

home.title: Make your GitHub profile truly yours
home.description: Start from your current profile, build your introduction with README templates and see the result before applying any change.
home.safetyNote: Nothing changes on your GitHub without your confirmation.

connect.title: Sign in with GitHub
connect.description: Your current profile becomes the starting point.

edit.title: Edit a draft
edit.description: Adjust your details and pick a README template.

apply.title: Review and apply
apply.description: Check the preview and confirm before anything is sent to GitHub.

errorPage.title: Something went wrong
errorPage.description: An unexpected error happened while loading this page. Your saved drafts were not affected.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: This address does not exist, or the draft was deleted.

charCount.remaining: {count, plural, =0 {Character limit reached} one {# character left} other {# characters left}}
